title: Husain's sacrifice
body:
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life......
Hussain hussain ...
All thanks to imam hussain(pbuh) that the heart of humanity is still beating
Hussain hussain...
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life ..(4)
(1)We have learned so many lessons from your tragedy
And from all those who are part of your great story
If for a moment someone was to stop and see..(2)
There's no doubt they would say likes yours there is no day..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(2) In history a man like you we cannot find
You left for karbala leaving everything behind
Protecting the right path is all you had in your mind..(2)
So by truth we will stand with your flag in our hands..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(3) They were all so young children present with you
When the time came young qasim knew what to do
He says any outcome is sweet if your cause is true..(2)
We'll raise our children this way they'll fight for you one day..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(4) Not once did the decision your companions doubt
Even though their result they surely knew about
You gave them the chance  to save   their lives and bail out..(2)
We will not fear death if we are on the right path..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(5) When we think about abbas your dear brother
Not once did he call you anything but master
So loyal to Zainab to you hussain and your daughter..(2)
Abbas's life we'll observe and our master we will serve..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(6)When thinking of sajjad with sadness our hearts are filled
He was strong and brave on the battlefield was skilled
He had to watch all his family members be killed..(2)
Sajjad's patience teaches us in allah we must trust..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(7) Your daughter sakina her thirst was not quenched
When her uncle returned in blood he was drenched
How will i now help my brother she questioned..(2)
We will  think about others and  put their needs first  ..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
(8) After losing everything Zainab  still stood strong
She showed all of us the path of right and wrong
Close to her and her loved ones is where we belong..(2)
Hashimi sisters will this wish of hers fulfill..(2)
Hussain your sacrifice has become our way of life..(2)
